trainer/30155.htm.text: Master Ellenia: When Humans were still swinging crude wooden clubs, we children of the forest had already mastered the art of sword and bow. Our Elven martial legacy spans millennia...

trainer/30155-noteach.htm.text: Master Ellenia: Only Elven Fighters can benefit from my training. There is nothing that I can teach you.

Have you given the enemy of our race a harsh punishment they will not soon forget? According to the terms of our Contract, I will reward you according to the number of fangs you have brought. Q00316_DestroyPlagueCarriers/30155-05.ht.text: Master Ellenia: The eradication of the plague bringers has begun! Please hurry to the abandoned Underground Elven Fortress. Do you remember the Contract you signed with me? Destroy the dirty ratmen and bring back their fangs as proof, and I will reward you for each item of proof you bring me. I wil…

links.text: Say you are going to go destroy them
Say you will end the Contract

Q00316_DestroyPlagueCarriers/30155-04.ht.text: Master Ellenia: Then I shall draw up our Contract. What you must do is to kill the ratmen and bring back their fangs as proof. I will compensate you for as many as you bring back. Furthermore, if you kill their leader Varool Foulclaw and bring back one of his fangs as proof, I will give you a great…

Q00316_DestroyPlagueCarriers/30155-08.ht.text: Master Ellenia: I understand. You too, need rest. Rest under the shade of the Mother Tree and recover the strength of both your body and soul. Well then, may Eva's blessings be with you.

Q00316_DestroyPlagueCarriers/30155-09.ht.text: Master Ellenia: The fight must continue. We should not leave any of them alive, those dirty villains that have polluted the Elven Forest with disease and collaborated with the dark race. In Eva's name, may they all receive the stillness of the grave!

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
